# Trump Super Intelligence

A conversation, not a match. There is no title card, no score, and no game over.

## The line

Type a line and press Return. The reply is the bold orange type above the picture. It breaks on words. Up and Down walk the lines you already sent. A long line can be pasted.

Praise him and he praises you back. Call him a fool, a fake, or a liar and he rants, and the rant gets longer if you keep at it. Ask who he is, or whether he is a machine. Ask what two and two is. He will do the sum. "Go on" keeps the last subject going.

## The face

The picture sits above the prompt. The reply sits above the picture. The frame around the picture is the mood, and the border of the glass follows it.

Green means you said something he liked. Say another kind thing and the frame turns gold, which is him winning. Orange is the ordinary mood, the one he starts in. Blue means he is thinking: a question, a sum, or the machine talking about itself. Purple is fake news. Red means you angered him. That picture is the one with the open mouth.

## The voice

Each mood plays a short tune. Then the browser says the line, in a low voice, if it has one. You hear him the first time you press Play. Escape cuts him off.

There is a cursor. Many people are saying that is still the whole game.
